name: The Eye of Ugin
aliases: the chamber of the Spirit Dragon
description: The stone hall in Akoum where the great hedron stands, the nexus point of the hedron network, and where the three Planeswalkers can summon each other.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nahiri recalls living among the kor for centuries, teaching lithomancy and training them to guard the prison, before withdrawing in apathy to the Eye of Ugin.
timeline.quote: She had trained the kor to keep watch over the Eldrazi prison

timeline.summary: Nahiri frees herself from her cocoon, goes to the great hedron, and sends a summons to Sorin and the Spirit Dragon.
timeline.quote: she sent her call into the Æther

timeline.summary: After waiting, Nahiri realizes Sorin and the Spirit Dragon have not come and she is alone.
timeline.quote: They hadn't come. Sorin hadn't come. She was alone.

timeline.summary: Nahiri, angry that Sorin abandoned her, decides to find him and wake him, and opens a pathway through the Blind Eternities to another plane.
timeline.quote: eager to find her oldest friend.

pages_say.description: The stone hall in Akoum where the great hedron stands, the nexus point of the hedron network, and where the three Planeswalkers can summon each other.
The lynchpin of the hedron network in Akoum where Jace hopes to find his answer.
The place Jace has gone to learn the power of the hedrons.
